summary: Assist Boulder County SAR with two Tier 3 Hoist Techs for injured 59 YOF climber at Rollins Pass (2020-58)
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team; Boulder County SAR
notes: ART mission 2020-58. Mountain-Ear/BCSO account: 57 YOF fell ~300 ft down a scree slope near the Needles Eye Tunnel on Rollins Pass while hiking alone; Flight for Life landed on Rollins Pass Road; BCSO case #20-3175; ~3 hrs.
